items.en: Snoek weather, say the uncles. The uncles have never once been wrong.
items.current: Isimo sezulu se-snoek, kusho o-malume. O-malume abakaze baphambe nakanye.
items.proposed: Isimo sezulu se-snoek, kusho o-malume. O-malume abakaze bahambe nakanye.
